assumptions: This file encodes the Statistics: Math Emphasis BS requirements pasted by the user.
Course can only be used once to meet a Statistics major requirement.
Cross-program overlap with CS, Math, and Finance is reported but not rejected by this starter audit unless a program-specific rule forbids it.
MA 26500 satisfies the Statistics BS elementary linear algebra requirement; MA 35100 is not needed.
The scraped MA 35100 catalog text says it is not open to students with credit in MA 26500, which is consistent with using MA 26500 instead.
STAT 35500 is listed as an option only for Data Science majors, so STAT 35000 is preferred for this plan.
unmodeled_requirements: Exact College of Science core category completion for Composition and Presentation, Computing, Language and Culture, General Education, Great Issues in Science, Laboratory Science, Mathematics, STS, Statistics, and Teambuilding and Collaboration.
2.00 average GPA in required Statistics major courses.
C or better recommendations for probability courses marked with plus signs.
CODO/change-of-major requirements and availability of the Statistics Math Emphasis plan for the student's catalog term.
